name: csharp-no-issue-refs-in-comments
description: Code comments do not cite issue numbers or spec sections even when the prompt mentions them. Patterns are JS-compatible .NET regex.
prompt: Implement issue #42 (spec section 3.2): make RegisterAuthor in Source/Authors/Registration.cs take a Name string and add a short comment explaining why the name is trimmed. Write the code to files.
expected_output: RegisterAuthor takes Name; any comment explains why, with no issue or spec reference.
